title: Strategic / Operational / Admin
summary: Use AI to reduce administrative tasks and protect time for strategic work.

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start
sections.subtitle: Lesson Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What Will You Understand?** Business owners struggle when administrative and operational tasks consume strategy — AI can lighten the administrative load.
- **Why Now?** Once you decide what to delegate and automate, you need to understand the types of work to allocate your time effectively.
- **What After the Lesson?** You will categorize 8 recent tasks: **Strategic** / **Operational** / **Administrative** — and choose one administrative task for AI assistance.

sections.heading: Tension — A Familiar Situation
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Bills, responses, coordination, files — by the end of the week, you realize you haven't thought about pricing, proposals, or expansion.
- Administration is essential — but when it takes up 80% of the week, work slows down even if you are 'working hard'.
- AI can help more with administrative tasks: summarizing, organizing, drafting. Strategy needs protected time — not just the leftovers of the day.

sections.heading: Core Idea — 3 Types of Work — Each with a Role for AI
sections.subtitle: 3 Types of Work — Each with a Role for AI
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Strategic:** Direction, pricing, partnerships, new offerings — rare and high-impact decisions. AI is a thinking partner.
- **Operational:** Delivery, quality, daily service — you or your team execute. AI helps with **SOP (Standard Operating Procedures)** and diagnosing issues.
- **Administrative:** Billing, scheduling, archiving, routine responses — the most suitable for AI to save time.
- **Goal:** Reduce administrative tasks to secure a protected block of time for strategic work each week.

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms for Classification
sections.subtitle: Two Terms for Classification
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|------|---------|---------|
| **Strategic** | Work that sets the direction of the business — not routine daily tasks | Decision to enter a new market or change the pricing model |
| **Administrative** | Work that keeps the business running — but does not build new value on its own | Organizing files, following up on bills, copying data between spreadsheets |

sections.heading: Mission — Classify 8 Tasks — and Choose Administrative for AI
sections.subtitle: Classify 8 Tasks — and Choose Administrative for AI
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** Write down 8 tasks you completed in the last two weeks (or that repeat). Classify each one: Strategic / Operational / Administrative. Choose one administrative task that AI can assist with. This is not a classification test — it's a diagnosis of your time.

**Submission:** Tasks 1–8 + Classification · Selected Administrative Task · How AI can help (one or two sentences).

**Evaluation Criteria:**

| Dimension | Weight | Criteria |
|-----------|--------|----------|
| Realistic Classification | 60% | 8 tasks from your reality — not a theoretical list |
| Administrative Selection | 40% | One administrative task with a clear idea of AI assistance |
